opening.argument: The video is centered on identifying and explaining Best Buy gift cards, including how they are used. Its title asks, "What is Best Buy Gift Card?", while the description says, "Learn more about Best Buy Gift Card and find out how to use it in the right way." The card is visibly identified as a Best Buy voucher and shown as usable in Best Buy retail stores or the BestBuy.com online store. Although the description promotes buying or selling through BuySellVouchers.com and states, "For Buyers: Discounts up to 35%!", the available evidence does not establish deceptive conditions, required private information, failed transactions, or resulting loss. The request to like and subscribe is ordinary audience engagement, not a stated condition for a purchase, sale, or discount.
